textPrompt: Create a breathtaking, modern, visually captivating website titled THE FUTURE OF HUMANITY: Life in 2080. Explore how emerging technologies, scientific discoveries and global innovations could transform human civilization by 2080. Design a premium futuristic website using midnight black, electric blue, cosmic purple, silver and luminous cyan, with spectacular gradients, elegant typography, excellent readability and cinematic visual storytelling. Create an extraordinary hero section featuring a photorealistic futuristic city with advanced transportation, sustainable skyscrapers and intelligent infrastructure. Include engaging sections exploring future transportation, humanoid robotics, advanced healthcare, space tourism, smart homes, renewable energy, digital education, biotechnology and the future of work. Use breathtaking, highly relevant futuristic imagery, sophisticated interactive cards, beautiful section transitions, creative layouts and generous spacing. Ensure all images accurately represent their surrounding content, with speculative future scenes presented as concepts rather than existing technologies. Include responsive navigation, compelling headlines, attractive buttons, subtle animations and a polished footer. Maintain consistent branding, excellent text contrast and professional visual hierarchy. Avoid unrelated photographs, broken images, unattractive colors, repetitive layouts and excessive text. The final website must look like a world-class technology exhibition platform that immediately captures the attention of investors, researchers and stakeholders.
